caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair with an ornate design. The chair features a high backrest and a seat made of woven cane material, giving it a grid-like pattern of tan and light brown. The chair’s frame is predominantly dark brown to black, with patches showing signs of wear, revealing lighter brown wood underneath. The arms are elaborately curved, terminating in a spiral scroll on each side. The legs are connected with horizontal stretchers, and the base is formed by two long, curved rockers. Yellowish accents line certain parts of the chair, adding detail to its contours. The overall composition is centered on a plain, unadorned background. Toward the lower right, the name "Joseph Fisher Del. 1850" is written in small text.
title: Rocking Chair
